sources_used: KPN N.V. FY20-FY24 Annual Reports + Q1-Q3 2025 results (https://ir.kpn.com)
_ordering_rationale: Telco NL pure : Consumer Mobile (>50% CA), Consumer Wireline (FTTH leader NL), Business, EBITDA AL margin, Postpaid Net Adds.

kpis.signal: ARPU mobile en hausse, 5G coverage 100% NL, mix postpaid premium
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Consumer Mobile KPN (mobile postpaid B2C Pays-Bas). Croissance ARPU + postpaid mix.
kpis.description_en: KPN Consumer Mobile revenue (NL B2C postpaid mobile). ARPU growth + postpaid mix.

kpis.signal: FTTH leader NL (~5.5M foyers couverts), conversion DSL→FTTH continue, ARPU +1-2%
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Consumer Wireline KPN (broadband fixe FTTH + TV + voix). Leader FTTH Pays-Bas, conversion DSL→fibre soutenue.
kpis.description_en: KPN Consumer Wireline revenue (fixed FTTH broadband + TV + voice). NL FTTH leader, sustained DSL→fibre conversion.

kpis.signal: Stabilisation Business post-restructuration, focus mid-market + cybersécurité (KPN Security)
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Business KPN (entreprises NL). Stabilisé après années de pression telco-legacy, focus mid-market + ICT.
kpis.description_en: KPN Business segment revenue (NL enterprises). Stabilized after legacy telco pressure, focus mid-market + ICT.

kpis.signal: Marge AL ~45%, leader marge en EU telcos. Cible +3-5% CAGR 2024-2027.
kpis.description_fr: EBITDAaL ajusté groupe KPN. Marge ~45%, leader rentabilité EU telco. Plan strategique 2027 : +3-5% CAGR.
kpis.description_en: KPN adjusted EBITDAaL. ~45% margin, EU telco profitability leader. 2027 plan: +3-5% CAGR.

kpis.signal: Acquisition nette mobile postpaid en hausse, gain de parts de marché vs T-Mobile NL + Vodafone NL
kpis.description_fr: Acquisitions nettes annuelles mobile postpaid KPN Consumer. Croissance soutenue, gain PdM Pays-Bas.
kpis.description_en: KPN Consumer mobile postpaid annual net adds. Sustained growth, NL market share gains.

kpis.signal: FTTH build-out peak passé, Capex ~21% CA, ratio descendre en 2027+
kpis.description_fr: Capex groupe KPN. Pic FTTH build-out atteint, normalisation 2025-2027 vers ~18-20% CA.
kpis.description_en: KPN group Capex. FTTH build-out peak reached, 2025-2027 normalization toward ~18-20% revenue.

_notes: KPN FY = calendaire. Sources : Annual Reports FY20-FY24 + Q1-Q3 2025 results.
